caption: The drawing depicts a full-length statue of a standing figure. The figure is dressed in a pinkish-red knee-length tunic, accented with yellowish trim and a sash around the waist. Wrapped around the figure's right shoulder and hanging down to just above the knee, there is a light brown fur pelt. The figure’s legs are painted with alternating horizontal bands of yellow and brown and is barefoot. The figure wears a headband with a large feathered headdress in shades of tan and brown. The right hand is raised, holding what appears to be cigars, while the left arm rests along the side, partially draped by the pelt. The statue stands on a gray square base, which has the word "CIGARS" painted in yellow block letters on the front. The background of the drawing is plain and uncolored.
title: Indian Woman
